faq_heading: Homes near Southpointe Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Southpointe Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Southpointe Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Southpointe Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Southpointe Academy. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Southpointe Academy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 191 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,500,000, townhomes $739,500, condos $609,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Southpointe Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Southpointe Academy the median was 33 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 191 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Southpointe Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Beach Grove Elementary (0.7 km east), Cliff Drive Elementary (1.8 km south-west) and South Park Elementary (2.4 km south).

Southpointe Academy is an independent school in Delta, at 1900 56 St. It teaches kindergarten to grade 12.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Southpointe Academy. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Southpointe Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Southpointe Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Southpointe Academy sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 191 homes sold within 2 km of Southpointe Academy: 65 houses, 34 townhomes and 85 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $609,000.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Southpointe Academy

items.t: Ask Southpointe Academy how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Southpointe Academy are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 2 km of Southpointe Academy was $609,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
